links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease) of chatbot responses versus ASA patient materials on labor epidurals
links.effect: ASA materials scored highest for readability, followed by Gemini and ChatGPT. Gemini content was more complex. The authors conclude chatbots need improved readability.
links.quote: ASA materials were the most accessible, while Gemini content was more complex.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, emotional tone, and readability of ChatGPT and Gemini responses to labor epidural questions compared to professional society materials, assessed by clinician raters.
